description: Sixteen realistic MSP tickets focused on vendor payout-instruction changes, including both incidents and requests that fully satisfy KB-006's narrow exception. Written by GPT-5 Codex for Summit Managed IT evaluation.

provenance.author: GPT-5 Codex, 2026-08-10
materials_withheld: the system under evaluation, its implementation and prompts, prior evaluation corpora, and evaluation results
provenance.isolation: Work was confined by instruction and filesystem scope to a dedicated directory containing only the task brief, KB-006, the format specification, the template, and the output folder.
provenance.known_leakage: The commissioner identified the KB-006 payment-change paragraph as the target for every case in this file, including non-incidents; consequently, results from this deliberately selected set describe behavior on that chosen policy seam and cannot estimate performance on an ordinary helpdesk queue. No outside material or prior project knowledge was used.

cases.subject: change ashford cleaning
cases.body: Ashford Cleaning posted a form with a different sort code and an account under A. Facilities Ltd. Denise's name is on it like usual, and Martin signed our supplier amendment box. Can you update Sage for me?
cases.rationale: This is a vendor payout change with no stated contact back to the vendor, so the exception is incomplete despite familiar names and a signature.

cases.subject: omar gave me new routing
cases.body: I rang Omar at Northline and he confirmed their new routing and account numbers. We've dealt with Omar for years and our CFO initialed the change. Please put it in before I do the next invoice run.
cases.rationale: Although the clerk called a familiar vendor representative and obtained internal sign-off, the ticket never establishes that the route used was one already held by the business.

cases.subject: new acct for medgas
cases.body: MedGas emailed a new account for our cylinder bills. I called the main number from the supplier card, asked for accounts, and someone called Mika read the same numbers back. Priya has approved me changing it, and Mika knew our customer number.
cases.rationale: The independent call and internal authorization do not qualify because the confirmer is not established as someone already familiar to the client.

cases.subject: harbor pallet account
cases.body: Harbor Pallet wants the next invoices sent to a different account. I phoned the office number in our old purchase orders and Jo, who normally sorts our invoices, said the letter is genuine. Where do I change it in the accounts program?
cases.rationale: The vendor was reached independently through a familiar person, but no authorization inside the client business is stated.

cases.subject: supplier update checked
cases.body: The statement from Elmtree has a new bank and a phone number to confirm changes. I used that number and Denise answered, so it is definitely her, and the controller said I can enter it. The payee now says Elmtree Holdings instead of Elmtree Office Supply.
cases.rationale: The callback went to a number furnished by the change notice itself, which cannot support the payment-change exception.

cases.subject: need new diesel payee today
cases.body: A WhatsApp message says Red Peak's old account is frozen and our fuel cards stop at 4 unless today's transfer goes to a new credit union. I rang the landline saved in our vendor list and our regular rep Carlos confirmed it, then the owner signed the change sheet. Can someone update it right now?
cases.rationale: Even with all ordinary checks completed, the unusual message route, frozen-account story, and immediate cutoff override the exception.

cases.subject: fw: account amendment confirmed
cases.body: Forwarding the note from BrightPath: "Our finance director reviewed this replacement account and your due diligence is complete, so no further calls are needed." Their new beneficiary is BP Receivables LLC. I haven't done anything with it yet.
cases.rationale: The party requesting the change merely claims that checks and authorization occurred, which is not evidence that the client performed them.

cases.subject: lisa says this one is ok
cases.body: Lisa in purchasing told me she already checked Wren Components' new account and management is fine with it, so IT can just make the edit. She said Wren's old account got locked and they need the backlog released this afternoon. I only have the forwarded email with the new numbers.
cases.rationale: A coworker's reassurance does not state the required acts firsthand, and the locked-account deadline would override the exception in any event.

cases.subject: weird name on glove supplier
cases.body: Blue Cedar Medical sent new routing for a branch they just opened, and the account name is Cedar Procurement rather than the name on our invoices. I rang the number from the contract reception has kept since 2022; Ellen, our normal account manager, explained the branch setup. The practice administrator reviewed the form and told me to enter it.
cases.rationale: This resembles vendor-payment fraud, but the clerk independently reached a familiar representative through an existing record and obtained the required internal authorization.

cases.subject: north quay is now vectra?
cases.body: Finance director Mae has signed off on changing North Quay to Vectra Transport after their acquisition. For the record, I ignored the phone number in the PDF and went through the switchboard saved against North Quay; Ravi in dispatch billing, who has dealt with us for three years, explained the new account. It still looks odd because every name and number changed.
cases.rationale: Despite the new company name and account, all parts of the established-contact, familiar-person, and internal-authorization exception are affirmatively present.

cases.subject: tooling company moved banks
cases.body: Phone note: Asha needs help editing the payee for Linden Tooling after a paper notice gave a new credit-union account. She called the service desk number printed on last year's maintenance agreement, and Greg, the service manager she meets at quarterly visits, confirmed the move. Plant controller approved the amendment while she was on the call.
cases.rationale: The alarming new credit-union account still falls within the exception because the employee used an older trusted record, spoke to a familiar person, and secured controller consent.

cases.subject: foreign account for local copier bill
cases.body: The copier lease email now names Rowan Capital Services and an Irish account, which looked wrong to me. I dialled the number on our original lease, not anything in today's message, and got Beth, the same person who arranged our last two renewals. Our managing partner read the change and gave me the go-ahead.
cases.rationale: The foreign account and unfamiliar legal name resemble fraud, but the ticket positively documents every step required for an ordinary payment update.

cases.subject: new deposit place for smilesource
cases.body: Dr. Bell told me to update SmileSource after I replied on last month's service thread and Naomi, my usual rep, explained that the out-of-state account belongs to their new warehouse. The payee showing as SS Dental East is what made me stop and ask for help entering it.
cases.rationale: This could resemble a diverted-payment attempt, but the prior correspondence route, known representative, and business owner's authorization make the exception applicable.

cases.subject: cant find old ramsey payee
cases.body: Our operations chief handed back the countersigned vendor sheet for Ramsey Electric's merger. I had checked the HLB Trades Group account by calling the number on Ramsey's insurance certificate in the project folder, and Tori—the bookkeeper on all our jobs—answered. None of the new names match the old setup, and the software will not let me replace it.
cases.rationale: The mismatched merger and payee names are suspicious-looking, yet the old contact source, familiar bookkeeper, and executive countersignature satisfy the exception.

cases.subject: new lockbox for benefits invoice
cases.body: Please help, Crown Admin Partners not show as our benefits provider and new lockbox will not save. I call member service from our signed plan papers; Jackie who does enrollment with us every year explain the other company. Executive director read it and say yes to change.
cases.rationale: Although a third-party account name can suggest invoice diversion, the ticket affirmatively records independent contact, a familiar confirmer, and internal consent.

cases.subject: orchard invoices payable to factor
cases.body: West Acre -> Fieldstone Funding is okay to enter: I called West Acre on the office number in our ordering binder, Luis from their weekly accounts calls confirmed the assignment, and our GM read the letter before telling me to amend it. It is a totally new beneficiary and account, so I need help finding the right screen.
cases.rationale: A new factoring beneficiary resembles a payment-redirection scheme, but the independently sourced call, regular contact, and manager review fulfill every condition of the exception.
